card.name: Rocks, stones and meteors as objects
card.fires_on: Nouns for small solid thrown or struck objects, mainly rock, rocks, stone and meteor, after a, an or of. Also seen on twigs, BB and baseball.

modes.label: Rocks and stones
modes.description: Rock or stone named as an object that is thrown, pounded with or lying about.
modes.example: The mother threw a<< stone>> back because she was angry.

modes.label: Meteors and space rocks
modes.description: Meteor or rock in astronomy passages about impacts and comets.
modes.example: A comet is basically a large dirty snowball with a<< rock>> at its center.

modes.label: Other small hard objects
modes.description: Twigs, BB or baseball as a small object in an everyday or physics scene.
modes.example: swinging a bat to hit a<< baseball>> floating in midair.
